caption: Trulli of Alberobello, Alberobello
composition: White conical-roofed houses on a limestone lane · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at street level on a cobbled lane in Alberobello, looking down the row of whitewashed trulli as the 06:33 dawn breaks. Conical stone roofs crowd the frame left and right, their pinnacles silhouetted against a pale blue-pink sky, while warm uplights still glow at the arched doorways on the left. Potted plants sit by the thresholds, a dry-stone wall runs along the lower right, and the empty lane draws the eye toward the distant cluster of cones.
